annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Governor of Minnesota (Mark Dayton)
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Governor's Advisory Council on Connected and Automated Vehicles to recommend changes to state law, rules and policies.
Council must report by December 1, 2018 on infrastructure, cybersecurity and data privacy, registration, licensing, insurance, economic development and equity.
Commissioners of Transportation and Public Safety to set programs and guidelines for developing, testing and deploying CAV technologies at every autonomy level.
Creates an Interagency Connected and Automated Vehicle Team to coordinate agencies.
Requires protection of individual and industry data under the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act.
annotation.summary_en: Minnesota Governor Mark Dayton's Executive Order 18-04 (March 2018) creates an Advisory Council on Connected and Automated Vehicles and an interagency team. It tasks them with recommending legal and policy changes and supporting safe testing and deployment of automated vehicles, with attention to equity, cybersecurity, data privacy and economic development.
